title: REEF TOPOGRAPHY CHART
description: 100% offline-ready Sunshine Coast reef chartplotter with live device GPS tracking, multi-tier reef topography, and 75-species intel.
info: Offline GPS Chartplotter: Streams live device GPS position (with SOG/COG, course-to-target vector, and simulated vessel mode), features multi-tier reef topography (aprons, gutters, ledges, peaks, wrecks, and 50+ micro-marks) from Coolum & Buddina Canals out to Barwon Banks (0–28 NM), and embeds the full 75-species database for 100% offline operation at sea.

title: CHRONOFIRE
description: Top-down 3D solo raid shooter where every death rewinds time, layering up to 5 past-self Echoes into your own 6-person fireteam.
info: Rust + Bevy WASM: Top-down 3D time-loop action inspired by Destiny 2 raids and Skillshot City. Charge 3 Resonance Plates under infinite enemy waves, shatter Aurelion's Aegis Prisms in exact activation order, and unload during synchronized DPS windows. Press R to bank an Echo and draft from 3 roguelike upgrades, or X to discard a run.

title: GEARS
description: 3D physics-driven spinning-mech brawler inside an AFL-scale stadium—tilt car-sized 13,000 RPM war machines to clash, ring-out, and burst rivals.
info: Rust + Bevy WASM: Deterministic 120 Hz tip-velocity Coulomb traction physics across a 140 m battle bowl ringed by 3-tier grandstands and Knockout Pockets. Assemble modular Tips, Cores, and Outer Rings in the Mech Hangar, mash to spin up inside Launch Holding Clamps, and brawl 2–8 GEARS with slow-mo clash cinematics, persistent Burst debris, and full gamepad support.
